conditions: The argument procedure accepts the single escape procedure. Invocations of the escape procedure obey the captured continuation's argument expectations.
limitations: Dynamic-wind transitions, multiple values, exact return behavior, and implementation cost have separate rules.

triggers: Exact publisher representation changed, source correction, or contrary language or edition evidence.

statement: In the July 2013 R7RS-small report, call/cc captures the current continuation and passes an escape procedure to its argument procedure. The escape procedure has unlimited extent and may be invoked repeatedly to use that captured continuation.
